text: ​ 💡 SPOTIFY HACK: SEARCH BY LYRICS 🔍 ​We have all been there: a song is stuck in your head, but you have absolutely no idea what the title or the artist is. 🧠 🎶 ​You don't need to use Shazam or Google to find it. Spotify has a built-in solution for this exact problem. 🛠️ ​ How it works: Simply open the Spotify search bar and type in the exact lyrics you remember. ✍️ The app will scan its massive database, find the song, and tag it with a "Lyrics match" label. 🏷️ ✨ ​A quick and effortless trick to save you from endless frustration. Time to finally find that mystery track! 🎧 💚
